column2: %s fleets for %s. Each one redraws all six ship types in a white and a black version — a fleet is purely visual: it changes neither how the pieces move nor the battle.
Shot and explosion sounds come from the ship's element, not from the fleet: the pawn fires kinetic rounds, the knight water, the bishop fire, the rook ice, the queen and the king electricity.
A battle plays the theme of the attacking ship.

%s maneuvers: twelve families that every ship flies in its own way, plus one of its own. Each is triggered by a gesture drawn on a 3×3 grid — like unlocking an Android phone — and costs energy that recharges by itself. The paths below are sampled straight from the game's catalog, so the ship on the canvas flies exactly what it flies in battle.
A mirrored gesture flies the mirrored maneuver
